#import data

```{r}
mytestdata <- read.csv("C:/Users/frayling/OneDrive - Université de Genève/Teaching_Geneva/Msc_Biomedical/Human_genomics_module_2026_2027/Dummydata_codebook/synthetic_gwas_teaching_dataset.csv")
mydataname <- paste0(params$data_folder,"/",params$data_file)
testdata <- read.csv(mydataname)

phenotypes <- testdata %>% select(1:18)
genotypes <- testdata %>% select(c(1,19:31))

write_csv(phenotypes, file = file.path(params$data_folder, paste0("phenotypes",".csv"))) 
write_csv(genotypes, file = file.path(params$data_folder, paste0("genotypes",".csv"))) 


```

#import GWAS summary stats data and subset by chromosome
```{r}
#CAD
GWAS_CAD_df <- fread("Z:/CDGG/data_external/GWAS_catalog/CAD/cad.add.160614.website.txt")
#select and rename only the critical columns before splitting
GWAS_CAD_df <- GWAS_CAD_df %>% select(c(1:7,9:11)) %>% rename(rsid = "markername", chromosome = "chr", base_pair_location = "bp_hg19", effect_allele = "effect_allele", other_allele = "noneffect_allele", effect_allele_frequency = "effect_allele_freq", standard_error = "se_dgc", p_value = "p_dgc", info = "median_info")  



#from Claude:
for (i in c(1:22)) {
  chr_df <- GWAS_CAD_df[GWAS_CAD_df$chr == i, ]
  fwrite(chr_df, file = file.path(params$output_folder, paste0("chr","_CAD", i, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

#Breast cancer
GWAS_BRCA_df <- fread("Z:/CDGG/data_external/GWAS_catalog/cancer/GCST010098.h.tsv/GCST010098.h.tsv")
#select only the critical columns before splitting
GWAS_BRCA_df <- GWAS_BRCA_df %>% select(1:12)
#from Claude to split and write out
for (i in c(1:22)) {
  chr_df <- GWAS_BRCA_df[GWAS_BRCA_df$chr == i, ]
  fwrite(chr_df, file = file.path(params$output_folder, paste0("chr","_BRCA", i, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

#CoRe cancer Fernandez Real
GWAS_CORECCAN_df <- fread("Z:/CDGG/data_external/GWAS_catalog/cancer/GCST90255675.h.tsv/GCST90255675.h.tsv")
GWAS_CORECCAN_df <- GWAS_CORECCAN_df %>% select(c(1:8,13)) 

#from Claude to split and write out
for (i in c(1:22)) {
  chr_df <- GWAS_CORECCAN_df[GWAS_CORECCAN_df$chr == i, ]
  fwrite(chr_df, file = file.path(params$output_folder, paste0("chr","_CORECCAN", i, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
```
